concepts.name: Tropical
concepts.classification_note: Tropical group: every month averages at least 18 °C, so there is no true winter.

concepts.name: Arid
concepts.classification_note: Arid group: annual precipitation falls below the dryness threshold set by mean annual temperature and the season of rainfall.

concepts.name: Temperate
concepts.classification_note: Temperate group: coldest month averages between 0 °C (or −3 °C) and 18 °C, with the warmest month above 10 °C.

concepts.name: Continental
concepts.classification_note: Continental group: coldest month averages below 0 °C (or −3 °C) while the warmest month still averages above 10 °C.

concepts.name: Polar
concepts.classification_note: Polar group: no month averages above 10 °C, so summer warmth is too weak for trees.

concepts.name: Tropical rainforest
concepts.classification_note: Tropical rainforest: every month averages at least 18 °C and every month receives at least 60 mm of rain.

concepts.name: Tropical monsoon
concepts.classification_note: Tropical monsoon: every month above 18 °C; driest month under 60 mm but above the 100−(annual/25) threshold.

concepts.name: Tropical savanna
concepts.classification_note: Tropical savanna, dry winter: every month above 18 °C, with a driest month under 60 mm and below the 100−(annual/25) threshold.

concepts.name: Hot desert
concepts.classification_note: Hot desert: arid with precipitation below half the dryness threshold and a mean annual temperature of at least 18 °C.

concepts.name: Cold desert
concepts.classification_note: Cold desert: arid with precipitation below half the dryness threshold and a mean annual temperature under 18 °C.

concepts.name: Hot semi-arid
concepts.classification_note: Hot steppe: semi-arid with precipitation between 50% and 100% of the dryness threshold and mean annual temperature at least 18 °C.

concepts.name: Cold semi-arid
concepts.classification_note: Cold steppe: semi-arid with precipitation between 50% and 100% of the dryness threshold and mean annual temperature under 18 °C.

concepts.name: Hot-summer Mediterranean
concepts.classification_note: Temperate, dry hot summer: coldest month 0–18 °C, warmest month above 22 °C, with a pronounced summer drought.

concepts.name: Warm-summer Mediterranean
concepts.classification_note: Temperate, dry warm summer: coldest month 0–18 °C, warmest month below 22 °C but four-plus months above 10 °C, with summer drought.

concepts.name: Humid subtropical
concepts.classification_note: Temperate, fully humid, hot summer: coldest month 0–18 °C, warmest month above 22 °C, with no dry season.

concepts.name: Oceanic
concepts.classification_note: Temperate, fully humid, warm summer: coldest month 0–18 °C, warmest month below 22 °C but four-plus months above 10 °C, no dry season.

concepts.name: Hot-summer humid continental
concepts.classification_note: Continental, fully humid, hot summer: coldest month below 0 °C, warmest month above 22 °C, with no dry season.

concepts.name: Warm-summer humid continental
concepts.classification_note: Continental, fully humid, warm summer: coldest month below 0 °C, warmest month below 22 °C but four-plus months above 10 °C, no dry season.

concepts.name: Subarctic
concepts.classification_note: Subarctic, fully humid: coldest month below 0 °C, only one to three months above 10 °C, coldest month above −38 °C, no dry season.

concepts.name: Tundra
concepts.classification_note: Tundra: warmest month averages between 0 °C and 10 °C.

concepts.name: Ice cap
concepts.classification_note: Ice cap: every month averages below 0 °C, so it never thaws.
